description: This file contains implementation code for big number addition functions (`bn_add.c`). It defines functions for adding and subtracting large integers represented by the `BIGNUM` structure, including `BN_add`, `BN_uadd`, `BN_usub`, and `BN_sub`. The code is part of a cryptographic library, likely OpenSSL, focused on arbitrary precision arithmetic.

methods.name: int BN_add(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs addition of two `BIGNUM` numbers, handling sign considerations and calling `BN_uadd` for unsigned addition.

methods.name: int BN_uadd(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs unsigned addition of two large `BIGNUM`s, resulting in a new `BIGNUM` that is large enough to hold the result.

methods.name: int BN_usub(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs unsigned subtraction of two large `BIGNUM`s, assuming the first is larger or equal, and handling borrow.

methods.name: int BN_sub(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * b)
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two `BIGNUM`s, handling sign and magnitude considerations, and calling `BN_usub` as needed.
